# ADR-3093: A08: Prefer reproducible builds for release train 9

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Non-reproducible builds obscure tampering.

## Decision

Release engineering SHOULD prefer reproducible builds for release train 9 (A08-9) when verifying supply-chain claims.

## Consequences

Differences are investigated before ship.
